description: Hooks for the oracle plugin. SessionStart injects the verification protocol. PreToolUse on Bash intercepts unpinned install commands. PreToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit warns when the target path has not been Read recently (transcript-corpus evidence: ~1,100 'File has not been read yet' / 'File has been modified since read' / 'String to replace not found' errors). PostToolUse on Read records the path into a per-session state file so the guard above can consult it. PreToolUse + PostToolUse on the plugin-scoped firecrawl MCP tools enforce budget-aware gating: tiered soft-remind / ask / deny based on monthly + rolling-hour + single-call thresholds, with state persisted at ~/.claude/plugins/oracle/usage.json. UserPromptSubmit + Stop + SessionEnd implement the session-summary checkpoint loop: cumulative agent-active milliseconds accrue on Stop only (user-idle time is structurally excluded); UserPromptSubmit checks whether 30 minutes of active work or 50 turns have elapsed since the last summary and, if so, invokes scripts/session-summary.sh to emit a CodeRabbit-style review (deterministic counts + LLM narrative via the model selected by /oracle:narrator, defaulting to Sonnet 4.6). SessionEnd prunes state dirs older than 30 days.
